definitions: To put to the proof; to try the quality of, or to try by a criterion; to subject to a test.
To try, as by a touchstone.
To try by a chemical reagent, or by some other experiment, or by the methods of science.
examples: They will test the new software next week.
The doctor will test your reflexes.
We need to test the water quality.
The car was tested for safety.
He will test himself against the best athletes.
